meta.program: Advancing AI Resilient Early Career Pathways (2026)
meta.note: RFP form from data/Grants/Current and Past/JFF/JFF - Advancing AI Resilient Early Career Pathways/. RFP released Feb 6, 2026; award $50k-$100k; submission via Google Form. The RFP states questions do not appear to have character or word limits; recorded as no limit.

questions.text: Project Overview and Innovation: Describe the challenge or opportunity facing early-career workers that your proposed project seeks to address. Why is this issue important in the context of an AI-driven economy? What is your proposed idea, and what makes it additive to existing approaches?

Operational Readiness: Outline your high-level milestones for the grant period. What do you expect to design, test, or learn by the end of the grant period? (Please note: a detailed implementation plan is not required.)

Please briefly describe your team's relevant experience and knowledge in AI and/or early career development. What perspectives or skills does your team bring to this work? If applicable, include the names and responsibilities of your partner organizations.

Early-Career Impact: Who are the early-career workers your idea seeks to benefit? How does your proposed work aim to improve access, job quality, skill development, or career mobility in an AI-transformed economy?
How will you assess whether your project is making a difference for the early-career workers you aim to serve? What outcomes or indicators would show progress toward your goals?

Learning and Scaling Potential: What are the key questions you hope to explore or learn through this project? Please describe how you plan to capture and share measures of impact and/or learnings during or after the grant period. If your pilot is successful, how might you envision scaling it? What key resources or support would help make that possible?
Team Bios: Please include brief bios for key project staff and partners, highlighting relevant experience.
Budget Summary: Please submit a budget and brief narrative describing how funds will be used.
